title: A Hymn for the Harvest
author: Ulyana Almeida
blurb: Elodie Marchetti, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
